text: Meet Yield Shifter. An AI agent that puts your idle stablecoins to work on Merkl, moves every pound through Stripe, and explains why. All inside a policy you write once.
On first run, it asks for your risk profile. Notice there's no low option. DeFi is never low risk. I'll go Very high.
Next: stables only, or allow some crypto exposure? I'll cap crypto at twenty percent.
Before a penny moves, it shows the UK risk warning. Everything can go to zero, and DeFi protocols get hacked. I have to acknowledge that explicitly.
My answers become a written policy. Minimum TVL, a cap per position, no borrowing, and a ceiling on yields that look too good to be true. It's saved, so it never asks again.
Now it scans every live Merkl opportunity in real time. The juiciest APRs get rejected, each with a logged reason. What survives becomes a diversified plan for my thousand USDC.
It's within policy, so the agent executes on its own. Each move is a real Stripe test-mode payment, carrying the Merkl opportunity, the APR and the reasoning in its metadata.
A week later, a Merkl campaign winds down and that APR collapses. The agent finds a better opportunity, refunds the old position through Stripe, and redeploys. No human needed.
And every pound is explained. The audit trail shows what moved, where, and why. Yield Shifter: autonomy, with control.
